title: Evangelicals affirm a duty to the Earth but doubt human-caused warming
subtitle: Evangelical Protestants and all U.S. adults, 2023-24
caption: Nine in ten evangelicals say God gave humans a duty to protect and care for the Earth, the highest share of any religious group in the study. Fewer than three in ten say the Earth is warming mostly because of human activity, and fewer than half say stricter environmental rules are worth the cost.
note: Share saying each statement completely or mostly describes their view; the two God-given statements were separate questions, asked only of people who believe in God or a universal spirit, with results shown as a share of all respondents. The warming question offered three choices (human activity, natural patterns, no solid evidence); the regulation question offered two (worth the cost, or cost too many jobs and hurt the economy).
